course_description: This course focuses on the development of applications using web, mobile and emerging technologies with emphasis on requirements management, interface, design, usability, testing and deployment, including ethical and legal considerations. 1

course_learning_outcomes.text: interpret the difference of front-end and back-development in web application;
understand Web Development concept by dealing with client-based case study;
implement Object Oriented way of programming;
Understand how to manage website using Model, View and Control;
develop and deploy complete Web Application in live server for pilot testing; and
demonstrate 21st century skills in all learning activities.
